scope: measure the sha256-tie-break 465-region union once from the same public indexed development ATAC fragment

source.interval_rule: a fragment record qualifies for region [beg, end) when fragment_start < end and fragment_end > beg; fragment_start >= fragment_end records are ignored

budgets.aggregate_transfer_note: finite cap; local tabix-chunk estimate is 3,171,155,968 bytes (3.171 GB); historical 480-region actual was 3,295,412,224 bytes against a 3,284,402,176-byte estimate (0.3% low), so the cap is ~26% above the estimate
budgets.temporary_disk_note: one 256 KiB BGZF window is held in memory per worker; no fragment bytes are written to disk
budgets.retained_disk_note: sparse counts.npz (~16 MB) plus JSON sidecars in a fresh output directory

cost_estimate_method: sum over union regions of merged tabix chunk byte spans, rounded up to 262144-byte windows, from the local .tbi; validated against the historical corrected 480-region acquisition

reuse_decision.considered: reuse historical corrected counts for the exact identical intervals
reuse_decision.reason: the historical matrix is keyed by the historical 480-region union order and no per-region reuse mechanism exists in the measurement tool; a single clean pass over the 465-region union avoids mixing two matrix assemblies and keeps one recorded measurement contract

stop_rule: if the aggregate transfer cap or a per-region 32 MiB cap would be exceeded, stop that acquisition with an exact cost/blocker record; do not accept partial counts, do not delete user artifacts, and continue independent baseline and feasibility work
